basic_info.description: Spectacular Big View, High Floor Condominium with gorgeous finishes throughout, expansive volume, period detail, special outdoor patio and one car parking. This beautiful Spanish Revival building spreads out over 3 acres of land, boasts brilliant natural light, has a stunning roof top shared deck/patio and sits across from one of SF's favorite and most centrally located parks. If you're looking for high end neighborhood living with amenities, this one checks all the boxes. Unit 606W is one of the largest 1BR units and is notable for its 10+ft ceilings, spacious open floor plan, and awesome walk-out, view balcony. The living room is anchored by warm rich wood flooring, over-sized view windows,  and extends into the perfect dining area, and high function kitchen with stainless appliances. Down the hall is the primary bedroom, an updated tiled bath, and ample closet space. Building amenities include a full-time front desk manager, deeded storage unit, and secure entry system. There is a spectacular  common view roof deck for the building on the 7th floor- just one floor up. And 1 car deeded covered parking space #103.
